g.text: Paired differences and 95% Monte Carlo intervals: comparison minus reference
All 3 DGPs × 4 tolerances × 4 metrics in each contrast. Open markers: MC interval includes zero. Common-success N: Table 3.
The sign indicates change in the named metric; it does not define a universal favorable direction.
